description: This file defines functions and types related to constructing and manipulating surrounding objects in Kubernetes API schemas, including accessors, builders, and metadata handling.

methods.name: NewRootObjectFunc
methods.description: Returns an identity function for creating a surrounding object from a focus value, which must be an object.

methods.name: WithTypeMeta
methods.description: Returns a closure that sets TypeMeta fields 'kind' and 'apiVersion' in the object if they are not already set.

methods.name: Child
methods.description: Returns a new SurroundingObjectFunc that adds a child key to the object and provides an accessor for it.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Returns a new SurroundingObjectFunc that treats the focus as an array and provides an accessor for its first element.
